articles.title: CoStar Closes $800M Cash Acquisition of New-Home Platform Zonda
articles.narrative: CoStar Group has completed its $800 million cash acquisition of Zonda, a platform specializing in new home-construction data, homebuilder software, and residential real estate marketplaces. This strategic move provides CoStar with a significant entry into the U.S. new-home sales market, leveraging Zonda's proprietary lot-level construction and development data, which serves over 3,000 homebuilders and related industry professionals. The acquisition also expands CoStar's consumer marketplace business with Zonda-owned platforms NewHomeSource.com and Livabl, and offers opportunities to integrate Zonda's visualization technology with CoStar's spatial technology for enhanced digital home-shopping experiences.

data_points.project_notes: Zonda generated approximately $170 million in revenue in 2025. CoStar's acquisition of the platform was first announced in May 2026.

articles.title: Michael Troyanovsky of Regency Development Group: 5 Questions
articles.narrative: This article features an interview with Michael Troyanovsky of Regency Development Group, discussing the firm's focus on residential development in Bay Harbor Islands, FL. Troyanovsky highlights the area's appeal as an "overlooked hidden gem" offering boutique living for empty nesters and those seeking privacy. The firm has four active projects in the submarket, with units ranging from $2 million to $10 million, and has adapted its future plans to accommodate unit combinations for larger families.

articles.title: JBL Asset Management Buys Retail Condo Near Miami Design District
articles.narrative: JBL Asset Management acquired a 25,504-square-foot retail condo, located on the ground floor of the Quadro building near the Miami Design District, from Alta Developers for $17.3 million. The property, completed in 2019, is situated at 3900 Biscayne Boulevard and is currently marketing its last remaining retail suite. This transaction occurs amidst a significant expansion of the nearby luxury Miami Design District.

data_points.notable_features: Located on the ground floor of a 200-unit condo building, facing train tracks just east of the Miami Design District.

articles.title: Now Is the Time to Buy in Commercial Real Estate: Morgan Stanley
articles.narrative: Morgan Stanley Real Estate Investing's mid-year 2026 outlook suggests that now is an opportune time to invest in U.S. commercial real estate, despite economic headwinds and high Treasury yields. The firm argues that a four-year downturn has led to repricing below replacement costs, creating attractive entry points for prime assets. This perspective is supported by dramatically reduced supply across all sectors and a strong macroeconomic backdrop, with U.S. GDP growth and increased transaction activity, capital raising, and debt originations in CRE. Morgan Stanley also highlights that real estate can perform well in sustained high-rate environments once cap rates have adjusted, and that elevated construction and financing costs will continue to constrain new development, supporting rent growth and value appreciation in existing assets. The report specifically identifies industrial, retail, and senior housing as sectors poised for strong performance due to megatrends like supply chain reorganization, AI-driven manufacturing, and aging demographics.

articles.title: Whole Foods to Open Daily Shop at Murray Hill’s 509 Third Avenue
articles.narrative: Whole Foods Market has signed a 15-year lease for a 9,000-square-foot retail space at 509 Third Avenue in Manhattan's Murray Hill neighborhood. This new location will operate under the grocer's 'Daily Shop' format, focusing on grab-and-go meals and essential groceries, a concept designed for quick urban trips. The 35-story building, known as The Murray, is a 229-unit apartment tower developed by Kahen Properties and Lalezarian Properties.

data_points.address: 509 Third Avenue, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Ground-floor retail space with outdoor terraces in a 35-story, 229-unit apartment tower.

articles.market_intelligence: Retail space in the nearby Herald Square area commanded an asking rent of $394 per square foot during the second quarter of 2026.

articles.title: Cushman & Wakefield Arranges $250M Refinancing for 506-Unit Multifamily Property in Seattle
articles.narrative: Cushman & Wakefield has arranged a $250 million refinancing for Museum House, a 506-unit multifamily property in Seattle. The financing was secured on behalf of a pension trust and provided by Barings. Completed in 2025, the property includes both market-rate and income-restricted affordable homes, along with ground-floor retail space.

data_points.notable_features: Features 404 market-rate apartments and 102 income-restricted affordable homes through Seattle’s Multifamily Tax Exemption program, with two residential towers connected by a glass-enclosed skybridge.

articles.title: Newmark Secures $45.9M in HUD Financing for Two Multifamily Communities in Grand Junction, Colorado
articles.narrative: Newmark has secured $45.9 million in FHA-insured HUD Section 223(f) financing for two multifamily communities in Grand Junction, Colorado. The financing package covers Nexus Apartments, a 122-unit property completed in 2024, and The Eddy Apartments, a 96-unit property completed in 2022. The Eddy Apartments notably offers riverfront trail access and amenities through a shared-use agreement with an adjacent RV park.

articles.title: CBRE Brokers $34.5M Sale of Turtle Creek Apartments in Riverside, California
articles.narrative: CBRE has brokered the $34.5 million off-market sale of Turtle Creek Apartments in Riverside, California. Turtle Creek Residential LLC sold the 98-unit multifamily asset to SC El Camino LLC. The property, completed in 2020, offers a mix of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments with modern finishes and a range of community amenities.

data_points.notable_features: Units feature stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, vinyl plank flooring, in-unit washers/dryers, and walk-in closets. Community amenities include a swimming pool, spa, fitness center, bark park, tot lot, and gated entry.

articles.title: MCA Realty Acquires Three Multi-Tenant Industrial Buildings in Salt Lake City
articles.narrative: MCA Realty has acquired three multi-tenant industrial buildings in Salt Lake City from a private investor in an off-market transaction. The properties, totaling 77,944 square feet, were built between 1998 and 2005 and feature 20-foot clear heights and 24 grade-level doors. MCA Realty plans to implement a capital improvement program to refresh the properties.

data_points.address: 515, 537 and 539 Pickett Circle, Salt Lake City, UT
data_points.notable_features: Properties feature 20-foot clear heights and a combined 24 grade-level doors.
data_points.project_notes: MCA Realty plans to implement a capital improvement program including refreshed paint, upgraded landscaping, enhanced parking areas, and modernized signage.

articles.title: Associated Bank Provides $50.1M Construction Loan for Multifamily Project in Flower Mound, Texas
articles.narrative: Associated Bank has provided a $50.1 million construction loan to Trinsic Residential Group for Aura Brookview, a 300-unit multifamily project in Flower Mound, Texas. The development will feature four four-story buildings on a 10-acre site within the larger Brookview master-planned community. The project is designed with modern amenities and unit finishes to attract residents in the northern-central part of the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex.

data_points.notable_features: Located within the 240-acre Brookview master-planned community; units will feature stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and in-unit washers and dryers; amenities include a pool, fitness center, coworking space, dog park, and outdoor grilling/dining stations.

articles.title: Interra Realty closes $2 million sale of Chicago apartment building
articles.narrative: Interra Realty brokered the $2.135 million sale of a 13-unit multifamily building in Chicago's Edgewater neighborhood. The property, which had not traded in nearly 50 years, was acquired by an undisclosed local buyer who plans a full gut renovation, including reconfiguring and adding units. The building is currently less than half occupied.

data_points.notable_features: Located less than a mile from Kathy Osterman Beach and close to dining and shopping along Clark Street.
data_points.project_notes: The buyer plans a full gut rehab, reconfiguring existing units and adding new ones.

articles.title: Lee & Associates brokers pair of transactions in Orland Park
articles.narrative: Lee & Associates recently brokered two separate transactions in Orland Park, Illinois. In one deal, an off-market 10,892-square-foot office building was sold by Marquette Bank to a private investor. Separately, Vision Land, LLC acquired a 13.3-acre retail land site, with plans for a future mixed-use commercial development.

articles.title: Cooper Commercial closes sale of two-building retail center in Solon
articles.narrative: The Cooper Commercial Investment Group recently brokered the sale of Kruse Commons, a fully occupied, two-building retail center in Solon, Ohio, for $9.3 million. The property, anchored by a national bakery-cafe chain and a regional ice cream shop, was acquired by an undisclosed buyer at a 6.79% capitalization rate. This transaction marks the second time Cooper Commercial has facilitated the sale of this asset within 18 months, highlighting the firm's strong market relationships and the property's appeal as a stable, income-producing asset in a robust suburban market.

data_points.project_notes: This is the second time Cooper Commercial Investment Group has sold the property within 18 months.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap closes sale of Fogo de Chao restaurant in Katy
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has brokered the sale of a net-leased Fogo de Chao restaurant in Katy, Texas, for $7.5 million. The property, built in 2017, was acquired by a California-based investor as part of an all-cash 1031 exchange, with the buyer intending to hold it as a long-term investment. The seller was a developer.

data_points.notable_features: Located near the Interstate 10 and State Highway 99 interchange, close to Costco and other national retailers.
data_points.project_notes: Property is subject to a long-term triple-net lease with more than 13 years remaining.

articles.title: Northmarq provides $102 million in capitalization for Baytown industrial park
articles.narrative: Northmarq's Houston Debt + Equity team secured $102 million in capitalization for the second phase of Port 99, a three-building, Class A industrial park in Baytown, Texas. The financing, arranged for Provident Realty Advisors and its joint venture partner Junction Commercial Real Estate, will fund the immediate development of nearly 1.35 million square feet of distribution and warehouse space. This project aims to meet the strong demand for industrial facilities in the rapidly expanding Southeast (Port) Houston submarket, driven by port activity and the recently completed Grand Parkway expansion.

data_points.notable_features: Class A industrial park with cross-dock and front-load configurations, including additional trailer parking, located in the Southeast (Port) Houston submarket.
data_points.project_notes: Northmarq has arranged over $125 million in capitalization for the entire Port 99 project, financing more than 2.6 million square feet of Class A industrial development.

articles.title: Zimmet Law Group Signs 10-Year Lease for 515 Madison Ave.
articles.narrative: Zimmet Law Group P.C. has signed a 10-year lease for 5,476 square feet of office space at 515 Madison Avenue in Manhattan's Plaza District. The law firm is relocating its Manhattan office from 477 Madison Avenue and is expected to take occupancy later this year after the completion of its new space. The landlord noted that professional services firms continue to seek high-quality, well-located office space, underscoring the appeal of the building and the Plaza District.

data_points.address: 515 Madison Ave, New York City, NY
data_points.project_notes: Zimmet Law Group will occupy Suite 603 on the sixth floor.

articles.title: Avison Young Recapitalization Provides “War Chest” for Further Growth
articles.narrative: Avison Young has announced a recapitalization expected to close in October, which will significantly deleverage the company's balance sheet by reducing debt and preferred equity by nearly 70%. This strategic move aims to provide a "war chest" for future growth, enabling the firm to pursue strategic acquisitions, broaden its service platform, and expand its talent pool through recruitment. The transaction involves a 70% debt-to-equity swap, converting financial stakeholders into equity holders and resulting in an approximately 50-50 ownership split between Avison Young principals and the former lenders, positioning the company for substantial upsizing and global expansion.

articles.title: Local Owner-Operator Snags Pico-Robertson Apartment Property
articles.narrative: A 16-unit multifamily property in Los Angeles' Pico-Robertson neighborhood has been sold for $5.3 million. The asset, which had been under the same ownership for 23 years, attracted significant buyer interest due to its desirable location and large floor plans. The new owner-operator plans to implement renovations as units turn over, indicating a long-term investment strategy.

data_points.address: 1476 S Shenandoah St., Los Angeles, CA
data_points.project_notes: Property had been held by the same ownership for 23 years.

articles.title: Grocery-Anchored Queens Retail Secures $32M Financing
articles.narrative: Northmarq's New York Metro Debt + Equity team secured $32 million in financing for Springnex Plaza, a fully occupied, grocery-anchored retail center in Queens. The loan was arranged on behalf of the owner, Mattone Group Springnex LLC, through Principal Financial Group. The property, developed in 2000, has maintained strong occupancy, which continues to attract significant lender interest for supermarket-anchored shopping centers in the current market.

data_points.notable_features: Grocery-anchored retail center with a diverse mix of local and national tenants including dining, healthcare, and service-oriented businesses.

articles.title: Brixton Capital Launches Multifamily Investment-Management Platform
articles.narrative: Brixton Capital's Residential division has launched a new multifamily investment-management platform aimed at institutional investors, family offices, lenders, and joint venture partners. This initiative seeks to enhance the performance and value of complex multifamily assets by integrating Brixton's investment and asset management expertise with the operational capabilities of its affiliate, United Apartment Group. The platform targets properties where current sponsors may lack the necessary capital, operating infrastructure, or institutional asset-management capabilities for future ownership phases, offering a comprehensive solution beyond just property management.

articles.title: Power Availability Becomes New Requirement For Shifting Bay Area Industrial Base
articles.narrative: The Bay Area industrial market is experiencing a significant shift in tenant requirements, with power availability emerging as a critical factor. This change is driven by the increasing demand from artificial intelligence and robotics companies for facilities capable of supporting high energy consumption. The market is adapting to provide power-ready spaces to meet these specialized needs.

articles.title: After Departing Trump Admin, HUD's Former Philly Head Joins Local Planning Commission
articles.narrative: Robert Ford, formerly the head of HUD's Philadelphia region, has been appointed to a local planning commission. This new role follows his previous transitions into real estate sales and football coaching after his departure from the Trump administration.

articles.title: Local Coffee Shop To Open Third Location: The Denver Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Convict Coffee Co., a coffee shop founded in Parker in 2024, is expanding its presence in Denver with the opening of its third location.

articles.title: Cross Ocean Partners, Fuller Realty Acquire 829K SF Houston Office Campus
articles.narrative: Cross Ocean Partners and Fuller Realty have acquired Eldridge Place, an 829,000-square-foot office campus located in Houston's Energy Corridor. This acquisition represents a significant investment in a key submarket.

articles.title: The Honest Co. Moving HQ To The Bluffs: The Los Angeles Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: The Honest Co. has signed a 10-year lease to relocate its headquarters to The Bluffs, a property owned by Lincoln. The move is anticipated to be completed by May 2027.
